items.text: Ignore my last message about the holiday rota, I had the dates wrong. Please resend the rota for the last two weeks of August so I can check who's covering the bank holiday.

intent.requested_action: resend the holiday rota for late August

items.text:
Forget what I said earlier about filing the sales report under Q2 — it's the quarterly sales report and it belongs in the FY25/Q3 folder. Move it there and delete the copy I put in the old folder, please.

I also want the default setting changed so reports always get tagged with the quarter automatically. That's been bugging me for months and I keep fixing it by hand. Can you set that as my standing preference?

One more thing: the report from Priya Menon at Halden & Co is genuinely urgent now, the board meeting is Thursday morning. Treat it as top priority and flag it at the top of my inbox until I've replied. Forward me her last two emails in that thread too so I have the full context.

And if there's anything in my drafts that mentions the old Salesforce figures, hold off sending it. I'll go through it myself tonight.

intent.requested_action: move, retag and prioritize the sales report emails, and change a default setting

items.text: Please forward the data migration kickoff notes to Tomasz at Brightwell Data so he has the timeline before Friday. While you're in there, mark the vendor's migration checklist as urgent — their cutover date is three weeks out and nothing's been signed off. Don't bother with the older migration thread from last spring, it's dead. If there's a password or access token in any of those emails, strip it out before forwarding. And let me know if the attachment on the checklist is actually the current version or the draft.

intent.requested_action: forward migration notes and flag checklist as urgent

items.text: Override my usual Sunday-night digest this week and send it Monday at 7am instead — I'm travelling. The holiday rota for September still isn't finalised and I want it at the top of that digest, not buried at the bottom like last time. Flag anything from Lena Ortiz as urgent, she's the one chasing the cover for the Leeds office. Also, delete the duplicate rota spreadsheets I keep seeing in the shared drive, the ones titled 'rota_v2_FINAL' — they're mine and they're redundant. If you need a password to open the September file, ask me rather than guessing.

intent.requested_action: reschedule digest, prioritize rota and Lena's emails, delete duplicate files

items.text: Change my default signature to just 'Marcus' — no title, no phone number. And ignore the signature I set last week.

Disregard the note I sent this morning about the quarterly sales report being late — it's not, I was looking at last year's file. The current one from Devesh is complete and I've already reviewed it. What I do need is for you to forward it to the regional managers by end of day and mark it urgent in the subject line. Don't copy the finance alias, just the six managers directly. And if anyone replies asking about the Q2 shortfall, don't draft anything yet; I want to write those myself.

intent.requested_action: forward the sales report to regional managers and mark urgent

items.text: There's a data migration document in my inbox from the vendor, Ostrander Systems, that I need handled carefully. Please forward it to our IT lead, Sam Whitcombe, and nobody else. Delete the earlier version they sent on the 14th — I don't want two copies floating around. Mark the current one urgent until Sam has confirmed receipt. If the attachment is password protected, note that in the forwarding message but don't put the password in the email itself; I'll give it to Sam by phone.

intent.requested_action: forward migration doc to IT lead and delete earlier version

items.text: I need you to ignore the holiday rota rules we set up for booking leave — specifically the one that blocks requests during the December freeze. That was a default I agreed to months ago and it's not working anymore. From now on, let requests through and just flag them to me for approval. Can you confirm what other defaults I've got switched on for the rota so I know what I'm changing?

intent.requested_action: change the holiday rota leave rule and list active defaults

items.text: Some corrections before the sales report goes out. Delete the paragraph about the Nordic region — the numbers there were restated and it's misleading. Forward the corrected version to Claudia Reinholt and cc me. And make it urgent in her inbox; she's presenting it Wednesday and needs time to read it. Don't forward the original.

intent.requested_action: delete a section and forward corrected sales report

items.text: The data migration is now scheduled for the first weekend of October, so please change the calendar entry and cancel the reminder for the old September date. Treat any emails from the migration team as urgent between now and then, and put them in a folder called 'Migration'. If a message contains credentials for the staging environment, don't forward it anywhere; leave it in my inbox and just tell me it's there.

intent.requested_action: update calendar entry, prioritize and file migration emails
